text: The Cambodia Sustainable Landscape and Ecotourism Project (CSLEP) is an initiative aimed at improving the management of protected areas and enhancing ecotourism and non-timber forest product value chains to boost rural livelihoods in the Cardamom Mountains–Tonle Sap landscape. The project, supported by the World Bank and the Global Environment Facility, focuses on landscape-scale conservation, sustainable livelihoods, and infrastructure connectivity across a 3.8 million hectare area, aligning with Cambodia's goals for protected area management and nature-based economic development.
